value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms St. Helena as one of 6 Napa County communities it serves (alongside American Canyon, Calistoga, Napa, Yountville, and unincorporated Napa County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes St. Helena/Napa County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Solar PV and ESS Permit Worksheet (completion checklist)

value.program_or_pathway: Over-the-counter permit (roof-mounted, no plans required if checklist is met)
other_conditions: Solar PV systems under 15kW DC qualify for streamlined over-the-counter processing
Energy Storage Systems (ESS) up to 80kWh installed in detached structures or on building exteriors also qualify
No review of plans commences until fees are paid
All permitting is digital and paperless via the city's eTRAKIT portal

permit_fees.notes: Costs vary based on system size and mounting type (roof vs. ground) but no specific dollar figure was stated on the page.
